_readme: DEATH SOUNDS THAT TERRIFY (SOUNDS 10/26/26, row [death sounds that terrify], rule 235): every death in a fight, from real recordings, through the bullets' own street, camcorder and tape (tools/bohemia_death_sounds.py). Every take's layers: the CC0 clip, the window in it, the speed, the place on the 16th grid, the level. The game reads index.json (tools/bohemia_death_sounds_level.js).
chain: layers (each through a 1:3 expander 24 dB under its peak) > street canyon (yours 10 m, theirs 28 m; an echo every 16th) > camcorder AGC (target -6 dB, yours up to +3, theirs +2) > tape > VHS band 100 Hz to 10 kHz > cut, a 16th fade > one loudness per voice

kinds.armour: the killing blow broke the last of his plate
kinds.skull: laid on top when the blow took the head
